title: Annex IV Glossary and Annex V Blank Assessment Working Paper
organizations: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime

reporting_intermediary_context: Authorities investigating or prosecuting money-laundering, predicate offences and terrorist financing
Authorities freezing, seizing or confiscating criminal assets
Authorities receiving cross-border currency and bearer-negotiable-instrument reports
competent_authorities.excluded: Self-regulatory bodies are not competent authorities for the reporting-intermediary definition.

functional_approach: Classify trade facilitators by the functions they perform with goods, documentation and financial settlement rather than by formal industry labels alone.
indicative_trade_facilitators: Freight insurance providers, unless reporting intermediaries
documentation_principles: Separate mainland and FTZ evidence where necessary
Document caveats, uncertainty and minority views
Convert material data gaps into action-plan items

source.title: Self-Assessment Guidance Manual for Trade-Based Money-Laundering Risk Assessment Tool
source.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
